OddsType.OddsDescription:
Standard 1X2: Predict the final outcome of the match in regular time. The bet offers three possible outcomes: 1 (home team wins); X (teams draw), 2 (away team wins)
 Fantasy 1X2: Predict which team/player will score most goals in their respective matches. If both teams/players score the same number of goals, the winning selection will be X. Both players must start the match. If either or both players do not start Goalscorer bets will be void. Extra-Time and Penalty shoot-out goals do not count.
Predict the final outcome of the match at regular time. There are 3 possible outcomes: 1X (home team wins or draws), X2 (away team wins or draws), 12 (home team wins or the away team wins).

Bet on the final result, but get paid out early if your selection (1, X, or 2) is winning at half-time, no matter the full-time outcome

Predict if both teams will each score at least one goal each during the match. The bet offers two possible outcomes: GG (both teams will score at least one goal during the match); NG (one or both teams will fail to score a goal during the match).
Predict whether home team will win atleast one half of the match.
Predict whether away team will win atleast one half of the match.

Standard DNB: Predict which team will win a match. Bets placed on this market will be void if the match ends in a draw.
 Fantasy DNB: Predict which team/player will score most goals in their respective matches. If both teams/players score the same number of goals, bets will be void. Both players must start the match. If either or both players do not start Goalscorer bets will be void. Extra-Time and Penalty shoot-out goals do not count.
Bet on Over 1.5 total goals, with the chance to win early if a goal is scored between 00:00 and 19:59.
Bet on Over 2.5 total goals, with the chance to win early if 2 goals is scored between 00:00 and half-time.
Bet on Over 3.5 total goals, with the chance to win early if 3 goals is scored between 00:00 and 59:59.

Bet on a double chance outcome with the chance to win early if the team linked to your selection takes a 1-goal lead. If the 1UP condition is not met, your bet will be settled as a standard Double Chance bet.
